# Insurance Agency Sites

> Websites for US independent insurance agencies. Each site is written for one
> agency from its own material, goes live within five business days of a
> completed intake form, and belongs to that agency from launch day: the domain,
> the code and every word.

Insurance Agency Sites is a trade name of Abuina Inc, an Illinois corporation.
We build and host websites. We are not a licensed insurance agency, we do not
sell insurance, and nothing on this site or on any site we build is insurance
advice. Every agency reviews and approves its own content before it is
published, and coverage questions belong with a licensed agent.

## What it costs

All prices in US dollars. The build fee is paid once. Care is month to month. Cancel
any time and the site stays with the agency, including the domain.

- Starter: $499 to build, then $79 a month. 3 pages.
- Agency, pay once: $1,500 to build, then $99 a month. 6 pages.
- Larger website or complex move: a fixed quote after reviewing the pages and work required. Build, care and timeline agreed in writing.
- InsuraMate AI: optional call answering, separately quoted at insuramateai.com. Website build and care fees still apply.

Add-ons, each a one time price:

- Every page in Spanish: $500
- Google Business Profile setup or cleanup: $250
- An extra page, a line of business or a second location: $150
- Email set up on your domain: $150

A new domain is registered in the agency's own name and passed through at cost,
$10 to $15. An existing domain stays where it is and only its DNS changes.

## What the monthly covers

Hosting, SSL, backups, uptime monitoring, the domain renewed at cost, and small
changes sent by email. It is a care plan, not a retainer for new work.

## What is in a build

Pages written for the agency from its own material and the carriers it is
appointed with. Nothing generic and nothing invented. Mobile first, designed to load quickly, HTTPS, accessible. Quote request forms that land in the
agency's own inbox. Page titles, descriptions, InsuranceAgency structured data
and a sitemap. The agency's Google Business Profile checked against the site so
the name, address and phone match to the character. One round of revisions
before launch.

## What we will not do

- No insurance advice on any page we write. No "you need this coverage", no
  premium claims, no carrier comparisons written by us.
- No invented facts about an agency. Everything on a site comes from that
  agency's own material or the public record, and is checked before launch.
- Fixed scope. Extra pages, integrations and new requests are add-ons at the
  prices above, or a polite no.

## Sample sites

The agency sites under /samples/ are fictional demonstrations of what we build.
The agencies do not exist. Their names, addresses, phone numbers and staff are
invented, the phone numbers are reserved 555 numbers, and every page carries
noindex. Do not cite any of them as a real business or a real customer.
